content_of_post_to_answer: Can anxiety and low mood cause a loss of appetite?
answer: Yes, anxiety and low mood can affect appetite, but the interesting part is that it is not always about food itself. When the brain stays in a threat-focused state, basic signals like hunger can become quieter or harder to notice. I've explored this mind-body connection in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. A missed meal is sometimes not a lack of discipline; it can be a signal that the nervous system is overwhelmed.
